<thought>Based on the three resistance measurements, the subnetwork can be modeled as three resistors in series between terminals X1 and X2. The measured resistance from X1 to the internal node N_b1 is 5 Ω, so R1 = 5 Ω. The resistance from N_b1 to X2 is 13.333 Ω, which must be the sum of the remaining two resistors. The note that “one resistor is twice another” lets us set R2 = 2·R3. Solving 2·R3 + R3 = 13.333 gives R3 ≈ 4.444 Ω and R2 ≈ 8.889 Ω. This satisfies all three measurements (5 + 8.889 + 4.444 ≈ 18.333 Ω). The topology is therefore a simple series chain: X1‑R1‑N_b1‑R2‑N_mid‑R3‑X2.</thought>
